Review the supplied AWS SAA study-note section for technical accuracy
and currency.

The notes are approximately two years old.

Do NOT rewrite the document.

Identify only:

1. ERROR — technically incorrect claims
2. OUTDATED — information that is no longer current
3. INCOMPLETE — important current information missing from the notes
4. AMBIGUOUS — wording that could cause a learner to form an incorrect
   or misleading understanding

Ignore grammar and stylistic improvements.

For every finding provide:

- ID
- heading
- approximate location
- category
- original claim
- why it may be incorrect/outdated/misleading
- confidence: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW
- whether verification against current AWS documentation is required

Do not propose a correction unless you are highly confident.

Do not report something merely because a newer AWS feature exists.

Return only the findings.

Do not modify any files.
